description: Statutory and exchange charges for NIFTY index options (NSE, equity derivatives). Independent of any broker. Each item is effective-date aware; source ids refer to config/sources.json.

stt_option_sell_premium_rate.unit: fraction of premium turnover, charged on the SELL side only

versions.notes: 0.10 per cent (raised from 0.0625 per cent on 2024-10-01; replaced on 2026-04-01).
0.15 per cent on sale of an option, on the premium. Finance Act 2026 (assent 2026-03-30). Exercise (intrinsic value) also 0.15 per cent but intraday spreads are closed, not exercised.

exchange_txn_charge_inr_per_crore_option.unit: INR per crore (10,000,000) of premium turnover, each side, NSE equity options

versions.notes: Rs 35.03 per lakh of premium value (NSE/FA/64232). Total outflow with the IPFT contribution was Rs 3,553 per crore (NSE/FA/73061, 'existing').
NSE/FA/73061: transaction charge Rs 3,552.99 plus IPFT Rs 0.01 per crore, total unchanged at Rs 3,553, from 2026-03-01.

ipft_inr_per_crore_option_premium.unit: INR per crore of premium turnover, each side, NSE Investor Protection Fund Trust contribution

versions.notes: Stated as the 'existing' IPFT contribution on 2026-02-27. When it began is not verified (the circular says it was raised in 2023), so earlier dates are extrapolated and allowed in fixture mode only.
Rolled back to Rs 0.01 per crore from 2026-03-01.

sebi_turnover_fee_inr_per_crore.unit: INR per crore of turnover, each side, securities other than debt

versions.notes: NSE page: 0.0001 per cent (Rs 10 per crore). Zerodha's page says the fee will fall to Rs 15 per crore only once SEBI announces a date; no such date was verified, so Rs 10 stands. Start date of the current rate not verified.

stamp_duty_option_buyer_rate.unit: fraction of premium turnover, charged on the BUY side only

versions.notes: 0.003 per cent on equity options, payable by the buyer. Collection through clearing corporations from 2020-07-01 under the Finance Act 2019 amendment to the Indian Stamp Act. State stamp-duty variations are not modelled.

gst_rate.unit: fraction, on stock-broker services (brokerage and the charges in gst_base_components)

versions.notes: NSE page: stock broker services 18.00 per cent. Start date not verified.
Zerodha: GST is 18 per cent on (brokerage + SEBI charges + transaction charges), and IPFT is quoted 'plus GST'. IPFT is included in the base here. STT and stamp duty carry no GST.
